statement: For the scalar reciprocal taper with M=2 and every positive integer degree m, the squared H2 residual is uniquely maximized up to common rotation at complete coalescence. Its maximum is B-1+4^(-m)m^2 B-2^(1-m)m binom(2m,m-1), with B=binom(2m,m).
hypotheses: All q_j unit, repetitions allowed; Q=prod(1-q_j z), A=1+2^(-m)(sum q_j)z; standard H2 coefficient-square norm.
verification: Subset exchange/conditional variance proof for m>=5; existing exact cases m<=4.

statement: For arbitrary integers m,M>=2, set L=m+M-1 and H=sum_(j=0)^(M-1) binom(m+j-1,j)(1-j/M)^m. If 4L^2(H^2-1)<1 then complete coalescence uniquely maximizes scalar reciprocal taper energy up to common rotation. In particular each fixed M is covered for all sufficiently large m.
hypotheses: All q_j unit, repetitions allowed; Q=prod(1-q_j z), A=sum_(j=0)^(M-1) ([z^j]Q^-1)(1-j/M)^m z^j; standard H2 coefficient-square norm.
